chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Abbad ibn Sulayman, from Muhammad ibn Sulayman, from his father, from Sadir

Sadir said: When he (the Imam) arose from his gathering and went to his house, I and Abu Basir and Muyassar entered upon him and said to him, May we be sacrificed for you! We heard you saying such and such regarding the matter of your maidservant, and we know that you possess vast knowledge, but we are not attributing the knowledge of the unseen to you. He said: O Sadir! Have you not read the Quran? I said: Yes. He said: Did you find in what you read from the Book of God, the Mighty and Majestic:
The one who had knowledge from the Book said: I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you (in the blink of an eye)

He (the narrator) said: I said, May I be sacrificed for you! I have read it. He said: Do you know who the man was, and do you know what knowledge of the Book he had? I said: Inform me of it. He said: A measure like a drop of water in the green ocean -- that is what he had from the knowledge of the Book. I said, May I be sacrificed for you! How little this is! He said: O Sadir! How great this is that God, Mighty and Majestic, should attribute it to the Knowledge which I am about to inform you of! O Sadir! Did you also find in what you read from the Book of God, Mighty and Majestic:
Say: God is sufficient as a witness between me and you, and the one who has the knowledge of the Book

He (the narrator) said: I said, I have read it, may I be sacrificed for you! He said: Is the one with whom is all the knowledge of the Book more understanding, or the one with whom is part of the knowledge of the Book? I said: No, but the one with whom is all the knowledge of the Book. He said: So he gestured with his hand toward his chest and said: The knowledge of the Book, by God, all of it is with us! The knowledge of the Book, by God, all of it is with us!

key_terms.الْبَحْرُ الْأَخْضَرُ: The green ocean -- a metaphor for the totality of divine knowledge of the Book
key_terms.الْغَيْبُ: The unseen/occult knowledge -- divine knowledge of hidden realities; the companions carefully distinguish between the Imam's vast knowledge and attributing independent knowledge of the unseen to him
key_terms.جُعِلْنَا فِدَاكَ: May we be sacrificed for you -- a formula of devotion and veneration used by companions addressing the Imams
key_terms.عِلْمُ الْكِتَابِ: Knowledge of the Book -- a Quranic phrase (13:43, 27:40) interpreted in Shia theology as designating the Imam's comprehensive knowledge of divine revelation

ai.seo_question: Do the Shia Imams possess knowledge of the Book (ilm al-kitab) according to al-Kafi?
ai.summary: In this narrative hadith, Imam al-Baqir or al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) demonstrates to Sadir, Abu Basir, and Muyassar that the Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt possess the complete knowledge of the Book. He does so by drawing an analogy: the minister of Solomon (Asif ibn Barkhiya) who brought the throne of Bilqis in the blink of an eye had only a drop of water from the ocean of the Book's knowledge -- yet God honored him by attributing knowledge to him. The Imam then points to Quran 13:43, argues that the one who has all of the Book's knowledge is superior, and gestures to his own chest, declaring twice that the complete knowledge of the Book is with the Imams.

en.sarwar: 3. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Hassan from ‘Abbad ibn Sulayman from Muhammad ibn Sulayman from his father from Sadir

who has said that he, abu Basir, Yahya al-Bazzaz and Dawud ibn Kathir were in the presence of abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.). The Imam (a.s.) came to us while he was angry. When he settled in his seat he then said, “How strange is it that certain people think we know the hidden facts. No one knows the hidden things except Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High. I thought to discipline our house maid, so and so, and could not find in which quarter she was.”

Sadir has said, “When the meeting was over and the Imam (a.s.) went home, I, abu Basir and Muyassir went to his house. We said to him, “May Allah take our souls in service for your cause, we heard you say so and so about the matter of your house maid but we know that you have a great deal of knowledge. We do not say that you possess the knowledge of (al-Ghayb) hidden facts.”

The narrator has said that the Imam (a.s.) said, “O Sadir, Do you not read the Holy Quran?” I said, “Yes, I do read the Holy Quran.” The Imam (a.s.) then asked, “In your reading have you found the following words of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High? “The one who had knowledge from the Book said, “I can bring it to you before you even blink your eye. . .” [27:40] The narrator has said that he said that he has read those words. The Imam (a.s.) asked, “Do you know who the man is? Do you know how much knowledge of the Book he had?” The narrator has said that he asked the Imams (a.s.) “Please tell me about his knowledge.” The Imam (a.s.) said, “His knowledge of the Book was like one drop compared to the green ocean (Atlantic). The narrator has said that he said, “May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, that is very little..” The Imam (a.s.) then said, “O Sadir, say, “What a great knowledge is that when Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, would ascribe to a knowledge that I am about to speak of to you. Have you found in the book of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, the following.

“Say, “God and those who have the knowledge of the Book are sufficient witness (to my prophethood).” [13:43] The narrator has said that he said to the Imams (a.s.), “Yes. “May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, I have read it.”

The Imam (a.s.) then said, “Is the knowledge of one who possesses the knowledge of the whole book greater or that of the one who possesses some knowledge of the Book?” I said, “The knowledge of one who possesses the knolwedge of the whole book is greater.” The narrator has said that the Imam (a.s.) pointing to his chest said, “The knowledge of the whole Book, I swear by Allah, is with us. The knowledge of the whole Book, I swear by Allah, is with us.”
